n1.speaker: sal
n1.text: Ryan! And you've brought your bodyguard. Sit down, mate. What are we doing today?

translations.fa: رایان! محافظت را هم آوردی. بشین رفیق. امروز چی کار کنیم؟

branches.suggestion: Hi Sal! Ryan has a school photo on Friday.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام سال! رایان جمعه عکس مدرسه داره.

branches.suggestion: I'm not his bodyguard. I'm his translator!

n2.speaker: ryan
n2.text: Er… a skin fade, please. Like this photo. But… not too short.

translations.fa: اِ… فید، لطفاً. مثل این عکس. ولی… خیلی کوتاه نه.

branches.suggestion: He means short at the sides, longer on top.
Ryan, tell Sal about the school photo.
branches.suggestionFa: رایان، دربارهٔ عکس مدرسه به سال بگو.

n3.speaker: sal
n3.text: School photo, is it? Then we'll make you look sharp. Do you want a skin fade, or a number one at the bottom?

translations.fa: عکس مدرسه، آره؟ پس خوش‌تیپت می‌کنیم. فید تا پوست می‌خوای، یا پایینش شمارهٔ یک؟

branches.suggestion: What's a number one?
Not skin. A number one, please.

cultureNote.en: Barbers use clipper numbers: a "number one" is 3mm, "number two" is 6mm, and so on. "Skin" means no guard at all.
cultureNote.fa: شماره‌های ماشین اصلاح: شمارهٔ یک ۳ میلی‌متر، دو ۶ میلی‌متر.

n4.speaker: sal
n4.text: The numbers are the clipper guards. One is very short, three millimetres. Two is six. What about the top? Scissors?

translations.fa: شماره‌ها شونهٔ ماشین‌ان. یک خیلی کوتاهه، سه میلی‌متر. دو، شش. بالا چی؟ قیچی؟

branches.suggestion: Number two at the sides, then.
Ryan, do you want scissors on top?

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Yeah, scissors on top. Just tidy it. Keep the length.

translations.fa: آره، بالا قیچی. فقط مرتبش کن. بلندی را نگه دار.

branches.suggestion: Ryan, say "please"!
How much will you take off the top?

n6.speaker: sal
n6.text: About an inch. That's two and a half centimetres. You lot use centimetres, I use inches — we'll meet in the middle!

translations.fa: حدود یه اینچ. یعنی دو و نیم سانتی‌متر. شماها سانتی‌متر استفاده می‌کنین، من اینچ — وسطش به توافق می‌رسیم!

branches.suggestion: One inch. OK, that's not much.
Inches! Britain is so confusing.

n7.speaker: sal
n7.text: There you go. Have a look in the mirror. Happy? Or could I take a bit more off?

translations.fa: بفرما. تو آینه نگاه کن. راضی؟ یا یه‌کم بیشتر کوتاه کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Ryan, are you happy with it?
It looks good. What do you think, Ryan?

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: Could you take a bit more off the top? It's still a bit long at the front.

translations.fa: میشه یه‌کم بیشتر از بالا کوتاه کنی؟ جلوش هنوز یه‌کم بلنده.

branches.suggestion: It looks great, Ryan!
Yes, a bit more at the front.

recasts.better: Could you take a bit more off?

n9.speaker: sal
n9.text: A little more off the front… there. Now you look like a footballer, not a sheepdog. Twenty pounds, please.

translations.fa: یه‌کم دیگه از جلو… بفرما. حالا شبیه فوتبالیستی، نه سگ گله. بیست پوند، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Ryan, pay Sal, please.
branches.suggestionFa: رایان، پول سال را بده، لطفاً.

branches.suggestion: Ha! Not a sheepdog any more.

n10.speaker: ryan
n10.text: Mum gave me twenty-five. Keep the change, Sal. That's a tip. Right?

translations.fa: مامان بیست و پنج داد. باقیش مال خودت سال. انعامه. درسته؟

branches.suggestion: Yes. A tip is nice, but not necessary.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. انعام خوبه، ولی لازم نیست.

branches.suggestion: Ryan! That's your mum's money!

n11.speaker: sal
n11.text: Cheers, Ryan! You're a gentleman. Good luck with the photo. And smile — no grumpy face this year!

translations.fa: مرسی رایان! تو یه جنتلمنی. موفق باشی با عکس. و لبخند بزن — امسال قیافهٔ اخمو نه!
